svg.title: Geographic concentration of retroactive-pay records
svg.desc: Fixed 50-km hexagons count deduplicated retroactive-pay implementation events by side. Safety and non-safety panels use the same scale; concentration is documentary coverage, not population prevalence.

g.text: Fixed-grid event counts show documentary concentration, not population prevalence

g.text: Shared safety/non-safety scale: 0–21 events per fixed 50-km hex. Difference scale: −21 to +21.
Unit: deduplicated municipality × cycle × mechanism × side event • 175 safety hexes; 34 non-safety hexes; 49 Alaska inset records retained separately • Evidence: canonical fixed grid; repaired input
Lower-48 map shown; Alaska is retained in the bounded data and explicitly documented, not silently dropped.
